data: In the top plot, what is the Oracle CIDEr value of the red line with a self-CIDEr of 0.70?

The question asks for the Oracle CIDEr value of the red line with a self-CIDEr of 0.70. From the caption, we know that the red line corresponds to a temperature of T=1.0. The top plot shows two axes: Self-CIDEr on the x-axis and Oracle CIDEr on the y-axis. The red line intersects the y-axis at approximately 1.38 when the x-axis value is 0.70. Therefore, the Oracle CIDEr value of the red line with a self-CIDEr of 0.70 is approximately 1.38.
